name: Paradigm Foodworks Inc
old_description: Shipping to US addresses only. Free shipping at $75.00 for orders within the contiguous 48 US states.
about:
Paradigm Foodworks Inc operates from Lake Oswego, Oregon, where it has been producing small-batch artisanal foods since 1981. The company is woman-owned, though founder names are not publicly disclosed. Its origins trace back to a focus on handcrafted condiments and preserves made in limited quantities.

The manufacturer produces a wide range of sauces, condiments, spreads, and jellies across more than ten product lines. These include charcuterie condiments, dessert sauces, fruit and berry spreads, barbecue and grill sauces, mustards and horseradish, pizza and pasta sauces, salad dressings, salsa and enchilada sauces, as well as Indian-inspired Masala Maza and Asian fusion Heaven & Earth lines. Specific items such as Apple Jalapeño Jelly, Apricot Cognac Conserve, and Arrabbiata Sauce illustrate the flavor breadth. Production is described as small batch, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Paradigm Foodworks sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce website, shipping to addresses within the contiguous 48 United States with free shipping on orders over $75. The product assortment suggests it also serves specialty food retailers, gourmet shops, and food-service operators seeking artisanal condiments, though wholesale channels are not explicitly detailed in the available information.

The company emphasizes its long-standing commitment to small-batch craftsmanship, a practice maintained since its 1981 founding. Its woman-owned status further distinguishes it in the specialty food sector.
